pages.text: Apply one hydra heart, rotten flesh, leather, hydra fang, and glowstone dust to a chestplate. Costs one defense slot and can be applied once. Grants Regeneration IV and prevents a lethal hit by restoring full health, with a 200-second revival cooldown. Both effects are disabled while immersed in lava or hot fluids, while burning, and for five seconds after fire damage. Fire and lava damage are doubled.
